sources.title: SUNDIALS CVODE usage
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: SUNDIALS IDA：DAE 一致初值與代數約束
related.titleEn: SUNDIALS IDA: consistent DAE initial states and algebraic constraints
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：局部權重合格與全域科學精度分別證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Demonstrate local weighting correctness and global scientific accuracy separately.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「SUNDIALS IDA：DAE 一致初值與代數約束」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付狀態導數表、逐列殘差、修復比較及一致初值交接紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Investigate SUNDIALS IDA: consistent DAE initial states and algebraic constraints using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a state-derivative table, rowwise residuals, alternative repair comparisons and a consistent-initialization handover explaining which quantities may be adjusted.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐項算 atol+rtol abs(y)，再做誤差比；以標準化後的兩個一計算範數。
代入三個數值，分別得兩列零；以 y1+y2=1 與 ydot1=y2−y1 兩條關係獨立核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate each atol-plus-relative contribution, then divide the corresponding error by that scale. Compute the norm from the two resulting ones, retaining the component table so weighting mistakes remain observable.
Substitute the three supplied values and obtain zero in both rows. Independently verify the equivalent relations y1+y2=1 and ydot1=y2-y1, making the check independent of the combined norm expression.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: FireWorks：動態 detour、停止界與科研血緣
related.titleEn: FireWorks: dynamic detours, stopping bounds and scientific lineage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：局部權重合格與全域科學精度分別證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Demonstrate local weighting correctness and global scientific accuracy separately.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「FireWorks：動態 detour、停止界與科研血緣」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩組缺陷歷程、動態 DAG、停止狀態表與血緣 manifest。
related.differenceEn: Investigate FireWorks: dynamic detours, stopping bounds and scientific lineage using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver defect histories, a dynamic DAG, termination-state tables and a lineage manifest showing which adaptive result authorizes each subsequent task and final aggregation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐項算 atol+rtol abs(y)，再做誤差比；以標準化後的兩個一計算範數。
列 1、1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16，標初值與四次更新；相等邊界明訂接受。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate each atol-plus-relative contribution, then divide the corresponding error by that scale. Compute the norm from the two resulting ones, retaining the component table so weighting mistakes remain observable.

List one, one half, one quarter, one eighth and one sixteenth, separating the initial state from four updates. Declare equality acceptable and identify the first qualifying entry rather than merely the final recorded entry.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
